attchmntText: Sundrop Brands Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of Investors and Analysts Conference Call held on November 06, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sundrop Brands Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 06th November 2026. The company reported a 21% year-on-year revenue growth in Q2, reaching a run rate of INR463 crores. Half-year revenue stood at INR891 crores, up 18%. E-commerce grew 43% year-on-year. Normalized EBITDA margins expanded by 240 basis points, with an adjusted improvement of 370 basis points. The portfolio includes Sundrop, ACT II, and Del Monte brands. Management cited strong FMCG demand and successful price corrections to offset inflation. The company launched 24 new products and completed Sales Force Automation. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Sundrop Brands Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results (Limited Review) for the Q2 FY'27 and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Sundrop Brands Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, on November 7, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 5, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, total income was Rs. 262.06 crores. Net profit after tax and exceptional items was Rs. 9.82 crores. Earnings per share was Rs. 2.60. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, total income was Rs. 504.83 crores. Net profit after tax and exceptional items was Rs. 20.88 crores. Earnings per share was Rs. 5.54. Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited took possession of a property in Nalgonda on November 4, 2026, against loan account LAP1MIR000148558. The outstanding amount was Rs. 2059915.
